title: B1 Error->mark_failed transition (5 guarded branches) has zero test coverage — fix rests on inspection only
evidence:
sweep.gleam step_t0 Error branch:
    Error(err) ->
      mark_failed(db, sentry, row.id, "T0 claim failed: " <> query_error(err))
sweep_mark_failed.sql:
SET status          = 'failed',
    terminal_reason = $2,
grep of the sweep integration test for failed/Failed/mark_failed/terminal_reason returns ONLY a comment:
322:  // Gate failed (form opened) -> cadence advances without sending.
(no status='failed' assertion, no out-of-range attempt_count seed, no mark_failed pin across all 13 tests)
detail: B1's defect is fixed — each guarded Error now mark_failed+Sentry — but the 5 new Error branches and mark_failed have zero tests. A revert to StoodDown reintroduces the poison-row loop undetected.
recommended_fix: Seed a due row at attempt_count>4 (out-of-range) — or force a guarded-UPDATE Error — and assert status='failed', next_attempt_at NULL, a specific terminal_reason, and that the tick continues for other rows.

title: awaiting_correction due-SELECT exclusion still untested (carried from r1)
detail: r1 note, still open. awaiting_correction is excluded only by the status filter; no test seeds it. A future due-SELECT change could silently re-select such rows.
recommended_fix: Seed a row at status='awaiting_correction' with a past next_attempt_at; run the sweep and assert summary.due=0 and the row stays untouched.

title: Guarded-update 0-row StoodDown branch + concurrent race still untested (carried from r1)
evidence:
sweep.gleam each step's 0-row branch:
    Ok(_) -> StoodDown
no_duplicate_t0_across_retry_test (line 257) runs the sweep twice SEQUENTIALLY; its second run returns due=0 (next_attempt_at is future, so the row is never re-selected) — it does NOT exercise the 0-row UPDATE StoodDown path.
detail: r1 note, still open. The 0-row Ok(_)->StoodDown branch (concurrent writer / pre-advanced row) is never hit; no_duplicate_t0_across_retry runs sequentially so its second run isn't selected at all.
recommended_fix: Pre-advance a due row (bump its attempt_count past the guard) then run the sweep; assert StoodDown with no second send and attempt_count unchanged.
